hooks.command:
echo 'Review hook triggered - checking if this was a review command...'
if [[ "${tool_input.command}" == *"review"* ]] || [[ "${tool_input.command}" == *"code-review"* ]]; then
  echo "Review command detected: ${tool_input.command}"
  # Get current PR number if in a GitHub repo
  if gh pr status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr view --json number -q '.number' 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$PR_NUMBER" ] && [ "$PR_NUMBER" != "null" ]; then
      echo "Posting review findings to PR #$PR_NUMBER"
      # Here you would add your actual review findings
      # For now, we'll post a placeholder
      gh pr comment $PR_NUMBER --body "🤖 **Code Review Completed**

Review findings have been generated. Please check the review output above for details."
    else
      echo "No active PR found or not in GitHub repo"
    fi
  else
    echo "GitHub CLI not available or not in a GitHub repository"
  fi
fi
